lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A semi-regular grid of high-luminance circular spots arranged in approximately 5 vertical columns and 4 horizontal rows across the visible lateral flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Diffuse vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect the horizontal rows of spots, forming a rectangular grid of nodes across the mid-section.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent horizontal linear feature along the upper third of the flank characterized by a sharp vertical gradient from high luminance to shadow.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: A low-density distribution of approximately 6 to 8 small, high-luminance blobs visible within the silhouette of the first dorsal fin.
